sentence: The original report of fluvoxamine or metformin for long COVID fatigue is retracted. A candidate replacement is present in the corpus, but it is not formally linked and its abstract results are withheld pending full-text reconciliation.
scope: Source status only; not an efficacy claim
interpretation_limits: Source status only. No favorable result from the retracted report or candidate replacement may support an efficacy conclusion.

sentence: A US trial of a 15-day nirmatrelvir-ritonavir course in long COVID found no significant difference from placebo-ritonavir in physical health score at day 28.
scope: Established long COVID; 15-day course; PROMIS-29 PHSS day 28
interpretation_limits: Abstract-level; 100 participants; phase 2; does not establish absence of any effect.

sentence: The only identified report combining nirmatrelvir-ritonavir with other antivirals in long COVID is an uncontrolled, self-selected case series of 24 clinic patients, which cannot establish benefit.
interpretation_limits: Limited to this search; author conflict of interest; subjective outcomes; registries not fully searched (ICTRP/CTIS gaps).

sentence: In two large outpatient trials of acute COVID-19, fluvoxamine did not shorten time to sustained recovery or reduce clinical deterioration compared with placebo.
scope: Acute COVID-19 outpatients; not long COVID
interpretation_limits: Acute endpoints only; STOP COVID 2 stopped early and underpowered; TOGETHER combination result (R-TGT-FB-PRIMARY) is a different intervention and not pooled.

sentence: Evidence on pemivibart in long COVID is limited to an uncontrolled three-patient case series; the product is authorized in the US only for pre-exposure prophylaxis in immunocompromised people.
scope: Long COVID; US authorization status as of fact sheet revised 9/2025
interpretation_limits: Case series cannot establish efficacy; registry trials (NCT05877508 posted results, NCT07021794 recruiting) not yet extracted.

sentence: In a 12-month placebo-controlled trial in 98 women with fibromyalgia, low-dose naltrexone did not reduce pain more than placebo at 3 months.
interpretation_limits: Single trial; fibromyalgia only; not long COVID.

sentence: In a 48-week placebo-controlled trial in healthy adults, weekly low-dose rapamycin did not change visceral fat, and adverse events were similar across groups.
scope: Healthy adults; compounded 5 or 10 mg weekly; 48 weeks
interpretation_limits: No lifespan or hard clinical endpoints; small trial; secondary subgroup findings not claimed.
